crossRefs.note: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword…
crossRefs.keyword: when they, etc. Heb. when the people had made an end to becircumcised. till they were whole

translations.web: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.
translations.bsb: And after all the nation had been circumcised, they stayed there in the camp until they were healed.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the nation, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.
